ValidationRule.description: When the Switcher Document Status has been updated from Attached to Invalid and Invalid Switcher Comment is blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( SC_Record_Type_Formula__c="Sales Support", ISCHANGED(SC_SwitcherDocumentStatus__c), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(SC_SwitcherDocumentStatus__c), "Attached"), ISPICKVAL(SC_SwitcherDocumentStatus__c, "Invalid"), ISBLANK(SC_InvalidSwitcherComments__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a comment explaining why the switcher was marked as invalid.
